title: W8A16, W8A8, or both?
intro: The graded quiz's favourite trap. Sort each property to the scheme it belongs to.

cards.text: Dequantizes to BF16 before the matrix multiply
Runs the math on FP8/INT8 tensor cores
Halves the bytes streamed HBM→SRAM per step
Speeds up compute as well as data movement
The pick when your GPU has no low-precision tensor cores

debrief: Both schemes compress the **weights**, so both halve data movement. Only W8A8 also quantizes **activations**, unlocking the fast low-precision tensor cores — data movement *and* compute. And the trap: neither 'loses more accuracy' — calibrated methods preserve quality in both. It's a performance split, not a quality one.
